title: Country-Rock Rhythm and Fill Form
purpose: Practice switching between rhythm support and short country fills while keeping hybrid picking, muting, chord tones, and pedal-steel bends inside a rock-oriented song form.
feel: country-rock with clear rhythm-versus-fill sections and moderate eighth-note drive

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: firm country-rock backbeat with enough space for rhythm/fill role changes

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: direct root-and-fifth support; avoid busy transitions that compete with guitar fills

tracks.name: Keys
tracks.instrument_intent: sparse piano bed marking harmony while leaving upper-mid space for double-stops and bends

provenance.notes: Original country-rock practice arrangement designed around explicit rhythm and fill sections.
